name: Gray marmot
desc: A burrowing rodent of mountain meadows and steppe that eats grasses and flowering plants. Many predators take it, including wolves, foxes and birds of prey.
about: The gray marmot, grey marmot, or Altai marmot is a species of rodent in the squirrel family Sciuridae. It is one of the larger marmots in the genus Marmota.
